spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Which device is having a bad time on Wi-Fi, and why?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/network/unifi.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Wi-Fi clients
spec.description:
Wireless devices UniFi sees now (the poller's own copy, never the other site's federated one).

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Weak signal
spec.description:
Devices below -70 dBm at their access point. Below that, rates drop and retries climb; a device that never moves may just be far away.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Low satisfaction
spec.description:
Devices UniFi scores below 80% satisfaction: its own blend of signal, retries and latency for that client.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Roams in range
spec.description:
Moves between access points over the selected range, every device. A burst of roams for one device is it flapping between two APs.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Weak signal clients

spec.expr: max by (name, ap_name, radio) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(unpoller_client_radio_signal_db{source_site="",wired="false"}, "radio", "2.4 GHz", "radio", "ng"), "radio", "5 GHz", "radio", "na"), "radio", "6 GHz", "radio", "6e")) < -70

spec.description:
Each device below -70 dBm, its access point and band, weakest first. Click a row to follow that device below.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Low satisfaction clients
spec.description:
Each device UniFi scores below 80%, worst first. Read it with its signal and retries to see which is to blame.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Most retries

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (name) (increase(unpoller_client_transmit_retries_total{source_site="",wired="false"}[$__range])) / (sum by (name) (increase(unpoller_client_transmit_packets_total{source_site="",wired="false"}[$__range])) + sum by (name) (increase(unpoller_client_transmit_retries_total{source_site="",wired="false"}[$__range]))) >= 0)

spec.description:
The ten devices whose transmissions most often needed a retry over the selected range. Interference or a weak link shows here before anything disconnects.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Reconnects
spec.description:
Devices whose association restarted on the same access point in the selected range, most first. A move to another AP counts as a roam instead.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Signal
spec.description:
Signal strength at the access point for the picked devices. Better than -60 dBm is good; below -70 dBm is weak.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Satisfaction
spec.description:
UniFi's experience score for the picked devices. A dip with steady signal is interference or a busy channel, not distance.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Retry rate
spec.description:
Share of transmissions that needed a retry for the picked devices, over 10 minutes. Steadily above 20-30% the link is struggling.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description:
Bytes to and from the picked devices. Poor scores while idle matter less than poor scores while busy.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Connected to

spec.expr: max by (name, ap_name, radio, channel) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(unpoller_client_uptime_seconds{source_site="",wired="false",name=~"$client"}, "radio", "2.4 GHz", "radio", "ng"), "radio", "5 GHz", "radio", "na"), "radio", "6 GHz", "radio", "6e"))

spec.description:
Where each picked device is associated now, on which band and channel, and for how long: shortest first, so a fresh reconnect is on top.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
